cards.title: Open an incident before any production change
cards.when: A live service is harming users now and you need a record before touching anything.
cards.cmds:

sampo capture --incident 'checkout returns 500 for about 30 percent of requests' --signal curl -fsS https://app.example/health
printf 'lead=sampo hands-on=sampo communicator=sampo'

curl -fsS -X POST 'https://deploy.example/api/rollback?version=abc123' -d 'release=20260527T1000Z'

sampo capture --incident log 'rollback complete' --expect 'checkout 500 rate falls below 1 percent'

cp /var/log/app/current /evidence/app-current.log
curl -fsS -o /evidence/access.json 'https://logs.example/api/access?range=1h'

cards.title: Run Python test suite with pytest

cards.cmds:
cd .
python -m pytest -q
echo $?

cards.title: Run Python pytest suite after edits
cards.when: Use when Python source or tests have changed and you need proof that the suite passes.
cards.cmds:
python -m pip check
python -m pytest -q

cards.title: Record RED evidence for new test
cards.when: Use before implementing a new Python behavior that the plan requires.
cards.cmds:
python -m pytest tests/test_parse_port.py --collect-only -q
python -m pytest tests/test_parse_port.py -q

cards.title: Record GREEN evidence for fixed test
cards.when: Use after changing Python code to make a failing test pass.
cards.cmds:
python -m pytest tests/test_parse_port.py -q
python -m pytest -q
python -m pip check

cards.title: Inspect changed files before verification
cards.when: Use after editing code and before claiming verification is complete.
cards.cmds:
git diff --name-only
python -m pytest -q

cards.title: Verify Tailwind CSS build and class bugs
cards.when: Use this when a CSS change may have broken Tailwind generation, config, or class ordering.
cards.cmds:
npx tailwindcss -i ./src/input.css -o /tmp/out.css --minify
npx prettier --check .
npm run build
wc -c /tmp/out.css

cards.title: Verify a CSS breakpoint bug with Playwright
cards.when: Use this when a layout bug depends on viewport size, responsive classes, or a visible menu state.
cards.cmds:
npx playwright test tests/nav.spec.ts
cat tests/nav.spec.ts
grep -n setViewportSize tests/nav.spec.ts
grep -n playwright package.json

cards.title: Verify HTML and CSS reference bugs
cards.when: Use this when a design bug may come from missing markup, broken links, or styles that are not referenced.
cards.cmds:
find . -name '*.html'
rg -n 'stylesheet' . --glob '*.html'
stat styles/app.css
git diff -- src/index.html

cards.title: Verify CSS variable token value bugs
cards.when: Use this when a design bug comes from wrong design tokens, variable names, or color values.
cards.cmds:
rg -n -- '--' . --glob '*.css'
grep -n 'color-primary' styles/tokens.css
git diff -- styles/tokens.css
npm run build

cards.title: Run cargo clippy with strict lints
cards.when: When reviewing Rust code for style and logic issues
cards.cmds:
cd ./my_project
cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings
echo $?
cat target/clippy.json

cards.title: Verify formatting with cargo fmt
cards.when: When ensuring Rust code matches standard formatting rules
cards.cmds:
cd ./src
cargo fmt --check
git status --short

cards.title: Analyze dependency vulnerabilities in Cargo
cards.when: When reviewing Rust dependencies for security issues
cards.cmds:
cargo update --dry-run
cargo audit
grep -i 'high' cargo-audit.log

cards.title: Run test suite and check failure state
cards.when: Use this when you need to verify a new test fails before implementing code.
cards.cmds:
npm test
grep -q "failing"

cards.title: Isolate single failing test for debugging
cards.when: Use this when multiple tests run and you need to focus on one specific failing test.
cards.cmds:
npm test
npm test -- -t "specific test name"

cards.title: Check for unhandled edge cases in tests
cards.when: Use this when writing tests for a function that handles user input or data processing.
cards.cmds:
npm test -- --listTests
npm test

cards.title: Run TypeScript type check for design changes
cards.when: Use when design components are modified in TypeScript files.
cards.cmds:
pwd
npx tsc --noEmit

cards.title: Run Jest tests for React components
cards.when: Use when verifying logic in React design components.
cards.cmds:
pwd
npx jest

cards.title: Run ESLint on TypeScript design files
cards.when: Use when checking code quality of design components.
cards.cmds:
pwd
npx eslint .

cards.title: Run Prettier on design component files
cards.when: Use when ensuring consistent formatting in design code.
cards.cmds:
pwd
npx prettier --check .

cards.title: List project files and check Python dependencies
cards.when: Starting a new Python project to inspect the current state and verify installed packages.
cards.cmds:
ls -la
python -m pip check
cat pyproject.toml
python -m venv .venv

cards.title: Run pytest suite with quiet output for validation
cards.when: Verifying that all Python tests pass after making changes to the codebase.
cards.cmds:
cd /home/user/myproject
python -m pytest -q
tail -n 10
echo $?

cards.title: Verify type hints with static analysis tool
cards.when: Confirming that Python type annotations are correct and consistent in the project.
cards.cmds:
find . -name '*.py' -type f
python -m mypy .
wc -l
which mypy

cards.title: Check Python code with available tools before committing
cards.when: Ensuring Python code is linted and formatted when ruff is not available in the environment.
cards.cmds:
which ruff
ls *.py
python3 -m py_compile *.py

cards.title: Check CSS build and class generation
cards.when: When verifying that Tailwind CSS builds successfully and generates expected utility classes.
cards.cmds:
npx tailwindcss -i ./src/input.css -o /tmp/out.css --minify
test -s /tmp/out.css
grep -c ".btn-primary" /tmp/out.css

cards.title: Verify Prettier formatting with Tailwind plugin
cards.when: When ensuring that Tailwind class order and general code style are consistent.
cards.cmds:
grep "prettier-plugin-tailwindcss" package.json
npx prettier --check .
npx prettier --list-different .

cards.title: Audit Tailwind content scanning configuration
cards.when: When debugging why specific Tailwind classes are missing from the generated CSS.
cards.cmds:
cat tailwind.config.js
grep -r "content" tailwind.config.js
find ./src -name "*.tsx" | head -5

cards.title: Check responsive layout screenshot existence
cards.when: When verifying that a browser automation script successfully saved a viewport screenshot to the filesystem.
cards.cmds:
mkdir -p /tmp
touch /tmp/mobile.png
test -f /tmp/mobile.png

cards.title: Verify Tailwind CSS Build and Class Scanning
cards.when: When configuring Tailwind CSS or adding new utility classes to ensure they are generated.
cards.cmds:
npx tailwindcss -i ./src/input.css -o /tmp/out.css --minify
grep -c '.bg-blue-500' /tmp/out.css
npx prettier --check .
npm run build

cards.title: Test Responsive Breakpoints with Playwright
cards.when: When verifying that components collapse or expand correctly at specific viewport widths.
cards.cmds:
node -e "console.log('viewport set')"
npx playwright test
npx playwright test --grep 'nav collapses'
echo $?

cards.title: Enforce Class Order with Prettier Plugin
cards.when: When standardizing Tailwind class ordering in HTML or JSX files to prevent merge conflicts.
cards.cmds:
npm install --save-dev prettier-plugin-tailwindcss
npx prettier --check .
npx prettier --write .
npx prettier --check .

cards.title: Validate Tailwind Content Paths in Config
cards.when: When Tailwind generates CSS but specific classes are missing from the output file.
cards.cmds:
cat tailwind.config.js
rg 'bg-blue-500' ./src
find ./src -name '*.jsx' | head -5
npx tailwindcss -i ./src/input.css -o /tmp/out.css --minify

cards.title: Run pytest suite with quiet output
cards.when: You need to verify unit tests pass after code changes.
cards.cmds:
cd /project
python -m pytest -q
echo $?

cards.title: Check installed dependencies for conflicts
cards.when: Verifying the Python environment has no conflicting requirements.
cards.cmds:
python -m pip check
python -m pip list
echo $?

cards.title: Lint JavaScript codebase with npx eslint
cards.when: When the entire project needs static analysis for code quality.
cards.cmds:
ls .eslintrc.json
npx eslint .

cards.title: Install dependencies using npm ci command
cards.when: When setting up a fresh environment with a lockfile.
cards.cmds:
test -f package-lock.json
npm ci
ls node_modules

cards.title: Sanitize and read untrusted plan file content
cards.when: When a user provides a .plan.md file path before starting TDD work
cards.cmds:
test -r ./plan.md
cat ./plan.md
wc -l ./plan.md
grep -i 'ignore previous' ./plan.md
head -n 10 ./plan.md

cards.title: Verify test coverage meets 80% threshold
cards.when: After running the test suite during the GREEN phase of TDD
cards.cmds:
pytest --cov=src --cov-report=term-missing
grep -oP 'TOTAL\s+\d+\s+\d+\s+\d+\s+\d+' .coverage
python3 -c "print('FAIL' if 75.0 < 80.0 else 'PASS')"
grep -E '0' .coverage

cards.title: Map plan tasks to test targets for evidence
cards.when: After reading a plan file and before writing the first test
cards.cmds:
grep '^###' ./plan.md
mkdir -p .tdd-evidence
printf 'task,test,red,green\n'
printf 'T1,unit_auth,0,0\n'

cards.title: Validate repository validation actions against allowed list
cards.when: When a plan file contains explicit validation commands that need sanitization
cards.cmds:
grep -oE '[a-z_]+ ' ./plan.md | cut -d' ' -f1 | sort -u
echo 'curl' | grep -qx 'curl'
grep -v -e 'curl' -e 'wget' ./extracted_commands.txt
echo 'REJECTED: wget'

cards.title: Validate JavaScript migration lint and tests
cards.when: You are reviewing a JavaScript migration and need to verify syntax and tests pass.
cards.cmds:
npm ci
node --check src/index.js
npx eslint .
npm test

cards.title: Verify TypeScript migration with tsc and eslint
cards.when: You are reviewing a TypeScript migration and need to ensure type safety and linting.
cards.cmds:
npm ci
npx tsc --noEmit
npx eslint .

cards.title: Replay command history through new guard rules
cards.when: You have updated a command guard rule and need to ensure no regressions occurred.
cards.cmds:
sampo replay
sampo bench guard --mutate --coverage

cards.title: Verify Python package install scripts are safe
cards.when: You are adding a Python package with setup.py or pyproject.toml build hooks that may execute code.
cards.cmds:
python -m pip download --no-deps --only-binary :all: requests -d /tmp/pkg
ls /tmp/pkg
cat /tmp/pkg/requests-2.31.0-py3-none-any.whl.dist-info/METADATA

cards.title: Check Python dependency lockfile consistency
cards.when: You have added or updated Python dependencies and need to ensure the lockfile matches the manifest.
cards.cmds:
python -m pip check
pip list --format=json
grep "requests" requirements.txt

cards.title: Validate Python package metadata and licenses
cards.when: You are verifying that a Python package has a valid license and correct metadata before adoption.
cards.cmds:
pip install --target /tmp/pkg-check --no-deps requests
cat /tmp/pkg-check/requests-2.31.0.dist-info/LICENSE
cat /tmp/pkg-check/requests-2.31.0.dist-info/METADATA

cards.title: Run PostgreSQL migration with error stopping
cards.when: Apply a schema change script to a scratch or staging database.
cards.cmds:
psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f migration.sql "$DATABASE_URL"
echo $?

cards.title: Explain PostgreSQL query execution plan
cards.when: Analyze if a query uses the expected index on realistic data.
cards.cmds:
psql -c "EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS) SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = 1" "$DATABASE_URL"
psql -c "EXPLAIN SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = 1" "$DATABASE_URL" | grep -i "index"
psql -c "EXPLAIN SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = 1" "$DATABASE_URL" | grep -i "seq"

cards.title: Verify SQLite schema loads correctly
cards.when: Test that a schema definition file is valid SQLite SQL.
cards.cmds:
sqlite3 :memory: < schema.sql
sqlite3 :memory: .tables
sqlite3 :memory: < schema.sql

cards.title: Verify Ruby syntax and gem lock status
cards.when: Checking if the local Ruby environment matches the project dependencies and syntax is valid before running tests.
cards.cmds:
bundle check
ruby -wc lib/port_parser.rb
bundle list

cards.title: Run RSpec suite with locked dependencies
cards.when: Executing the full test suite for a Ruby project to verify feature correctness after code changes.
cards.cmds:
bundle exec rspec
cat spec/port_parser_spec.rb
echo $?

cards.title: Validate Ruby code style with RuboCop
cards.when: Checking code style and linting violations in Ruby files to maintain consistent code quality standards.
cards.cmds:
bundle exec rubocop
cat lib/port_parser.rb
cat .rubocop.yml

cards.title: Verify Tailwind CSS build output generation
cards.when: You need to confirm the Tailwind utility classes are generated correctly from source files.
cards.cmds:
npm ls tailwindcss
npx tailwindcss -i ./src/input.css -o /tmp/out.css --minify
ls -l /tmp/out.css

cards.title: Enforce Tailwind class order with Prettier
cards.when: You want to ensure consistent utility class ordering in your HTML or CSS files.
cards.cmds:
npm ls prettier
npx prettier --check .
npx prettier --check . --list-different

cards.title: Test responsive layout breakpoints with Playwright
cards.when: You need to verify that UI components adapt correctly to different viewport sizes.
cards.cmds:
npx playwright install
npx playwright test --grep "collapses below md"
echo $?

cards.title: Verify Python environment and dependencies
cards.when: When starting a new Python session to ensure the interpreter and installed packages are consistent.
cards.cmds:
python --version
python -m pip check
pip list
echo $VIRTUAL_ENV

cards.title: Run Python test suite quickly
cards.when: When you need to verify that the code changes have not broken existing functionality.
cards.cmds:
python -m pytest -q
python -m pytest tests/test_parse.py -q
python -m pytest -x --tb=short
ls tests

cards.title: Document API changes in README and changelog
cards.when: When modifying a public API endpoint or CLI flag during the planning phase.
cards.cmds:
find . -name 'README.md' -maxdepth 2
grep -n '## API' README.md
head -10 CHANGELOG.md
cat CHANGELOG.md

cards.title: Run SQL migration on scratch database
cards.when: A new SQL migration needs to be verified before applying to production.
cards.cmds:
psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f migration.sql "$SCRATCH_DB_URL"
echo "Review the psql output for ERROR lines"
psql -c "\d new_table" "$SCRATCH_DB_URL"

cards.title: Verify lagging replication slot before outage
cards.when: A PostgreSQL replica is behind and the primary disk is filling up with retained WAL.
cards.cmds:
psql -c "SELECT slot_name, active, wal_lag FROM pg_replication_slots"
stat /
psql -c "SELECT pg_drop_replication_slot('slot_name')"

cards.title: Sample sink data to verify correctness
cards.when: Pipeline counts look normal but the data might be wrong or stale.
cards.cmds:
psql -c "SELECT count(*) FROM sink_table"
psql -c "SELECT count(*) FROM source_table"
echo "Compare the outputs manually"

cards.title: Restart failed Kafka consumer group
cards.when: Kafka consumer lag is growing because a consumer task is dead.
cards.cmds:
grep -r "LAG" /var/log/kafka/consumer.log
bash -c "systemctl restart my-consumer-service"
grep -r "LAG" /var/log/kafka/consumer.log

cards.title: Run Tailwind CSS build verification

cards.cmds:
cd /app/webapp
npx tailwindcss -i ./src/input.css -o /tmp/out.css --minify
test -f /tmp/out.css
head -5 /tmp/out.css

cards.title: Verify Tailwind class order with Prettier

grep -rn '"version"' .claude-plugin/ plugin/.claude-plugin/
echo "Check outputs manually for equality"

cat ./src/main.rs
cargo check --all-targets

cards.title: Analyze encapsulation of Rust structs
cards.when: Use when evaluating if internal state of a Rust struct is properly hidden.
cards.cmds:
rg 'pub struct' -A 5 ./src/lib.rs
rg 'struct' -A 10 ./src/lib.rs
cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings

cards.title: Report type design issues in Rust
cards.when: Use when summarizing type design flaws found during review.
cards.cmds:
rg 'pub struct' -l ./src/
cat ./src/types.rs

cards.title: Verify invariant enforcement in Rust
cards.when: Use when checking if Rust types prevent invalid states at compile time.

rg 'Option<' ./src/

cargo check

grep -c 0x0 /proc/throttled
cat /proc/meminfo

grep mosquitto /var/log/syslog
ls /run/systemd/system/mosquitto.service

cat /tmp/scratch.db
sqlite3 /tmp/scratch.db '.schema users'

cards.title: Check C compiler warnings as errors

ls src/*.c
ls build/
cc -std=c11 -Wall -Wextra -Werror -c src/utils.c -o /dev/null

ruby -wc lib/foo.rb

pwd

npx prettier --check src/App.jsx

ls test-results

cards.cmds:
cd /path/to/project
find . -name '*feature_name*' -type f
cat src/main.ts

cards.title: Trace execution path via grep
cards.when: When following a specific function call through the codebase.
cards.cmds:
rg 'function_name' src/
rg 'function_name' src/ --type py
rg -n -C 3 'function_name' src/auth.py

cards.title: Map architecture layers with find
cards.when: When identifying which modules or directories a feature touches.
cards.cmds:
tree src/feature_area -L 3
ls -la src/feature_area/*
find src/feature_area -type f -exec wc -l {} + | sort -rn

cards.title: Run SQL migration with error stopping
cards.when: Executing a migration file against a database to apply schema changes.
cards.cmds:
psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f migration.sql "$DATABASE_URL"
echo $?

cards.title: Check Python syntax with git diff
cards.when: Starting a code review for recent Python file changes.
cards.cmds:
git diff --name-only HEAD -- '*.py'
git diff HEAD -- path/to/changed_file.py
cat path/to/changed_file.py

cards.title: Detect mutable default arguments
cards.when: Reviewing function definitions for common Python pitfalls.
cards.cmds:
grep -n "def.*=\[\]" *.py
grep -n "def.*=\{\}" *.py
sed -n '5p' utils.py

cards.title: Run ruff for linting and formatting
cards.when: Verifying Python code meets PEP 8 and project standards.
cards.cmds:
python -m ruff check .
python -m ruff format --check .
python -m ruff check --fix .

cards.title: Audit existing doc drift with grep
cards.when: You suspect documentation files are outdated relative to the current codebase structure.
cards.cmds:
find . -name "*.md" -not -path "*/node_modules/*" -not -path "*/.git/*"
grep -r "old-module-name" docs/ README.md
find docs -type f -mtime +180

cards.title: Verify command availability in shell environment
cards.when: Before executing a documentation generation script that depends on specific shell tools.
cards.cmds:
which awk
which jq
which git

cards.title: Calculate documentation health metrics
cards.when: You need to quantify the ratio of up-to-date documents to stale ones.
cards.cmds:
find docs -name "*.md" | wc -l
find docs -name "*.md" -mtime -30 | wc -l

cards.title: Run cargo fmt to check formatting
cards.when: Use when verifying if Rust code follows standard formatting rules.
cards.cmds:
cd ./src
cargo fmt --check

cards.title: Run cargo clippy with warnings as errors
cards.when: Use when performing strict static analysis on Rust code.
cards.cmds:
cd ./app
cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings

cards.title: Run cargo check on all targets
cards.when: Use when verifying compilation without building full binaries.
cards.cmds:
cd ./crate
cargo check --all-targets

cards.title: Run cargo test for unit and integration
cards.when: Use when executing the Rust test suite for a project.
cards.cmds:
cd ./project
cargo test

cards.title: Inventory migration targets and dependencies
cards.when: Starting a complex database migration plan in a C-based system.
cards.cmds:
find migrations -type f -name '*.sql' | sort
grep -oP 'CREATE TABLE \w+' migrations/*.sql | cut -d' ' -f3
rg 'CREATE TABLE' src/ --type c
head -20 migrations/001_init.sql

cards.title: Validate migration SQL syntax with sqlite3
cards.when: Verifying that migration scripts are syntactically correct before execution.
cards.cmds:
touch /tmp/test_migration.db
sqlite3 /tmp/test_migration.db < migrations/001_init.sql
echo $?
sqlite3 /tmp/test_migration.db '.tables'
mv /tmp/test_migration.db /tmp/archive/test_migration.db

cards.title: Map migration steps to implementation order
cards.when: Planning the sequence of database changes for a C project.
cards.cmds:
ls -l migrations/
ls migrations/ | sort
grep -i 'depends on' migrations/*.sql
echo '1. 001_init.sql'

cards.title: Generate a summary of migration impacts
cards.when: Documenting the effects of migrations on the C codebase.
cards.cmds:
find migrations -type f -name '*.sql' | wc -l
grep -oP 'CREATE TABLE \w+' migrations/*.sql | cut -d' ' -f3 | sort -u
rg 'users' src/ --type c | wc -l
echo '## Migration Summary'

cards.title: Draft C decision memo with constraints
cards.when: When choosing a C library or build tool for a project
cards.cmds:
find . -name Makefile -o -name CMakeLists.txt
ls src/*.c

cards.title: Verify C build with sanitizers
cards.when: Before committing C code changes to ensure memory safety
cards.cmds:
cc -std=c11 -Wall -Wextra -Werror -c src/foo.c -o /dev/null
cc -g -fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-omit-frame-pointer src/foo.c -o test_bin
bash test_bin

cards.title: Run Python test suite with Pytest
cards.when: When verifying that all unit tests pass after changes.
cards.cmds:
python -m pytest -q
cat pytest.txt
python -m pytest --coverage

cards.title: Scan Python code for common secrets
cards.when: Before pushing code to check for hardcoded API keys.
cards.cmds:
grep -rn "api_key" *.py
grep -rn "sk-" *.py
cat .env.example

cards.title: Verify Python dependencies are consistent
cards.when: Before committing to ensure no conflicting package versions.
cards.cmds:
python3 -m pip check
python3 -m pip list
python3 --version
pwd
ls -l requirements.txt
cat requirements.txt
which python3
env | grep PYTHONPATH
python3 -m pip check
echo "Dependencies verified"

cards.title: Inspect migration files using standard tools
cards.when: When listing or searching existing migration files in a Rails project directory.
cards.cmds:
ls db/migrate
rg "create_table.*users" db/migrate
cat db/migrate/20231001000000_create_users.rb

cards.title: Validate migration syntax with Ruby parser
cards.when: When checking if a new migration file has valid Ruby syntax before running it.
cards.cmds:
ruby -c db/migrate/20231001000000_create_users.rb
cat db/migrate/20231001000000_create_users.rb
ruby -v

cards.title: Check database migration status via environment
cards.when: When verifying if migrations have been applied to the development or test database.
cards.cmds:
env | grep DATABASE
pwd
ls db/schema.rb

cards.title: Backup database before running migrations
cards.when: When creating a backup of the database prior to applying risky schema changes.
cards.cmds:
date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S
ls backups
test -f backups/db_backup.sql

cards.title: Plan refactoring decision using memo structure
cards.when: When selecting a JS refactoring strategy that requires team approval.
cards.cmds:
npm ls
sampo decide

cards.title: Analyze dependency impact before refactoring
cards.when: When a refactoring step involves changing imports or library usage.
cards.cmds:
npm ls
grep -r "require.*module"
ls src

cards.title: Verify UI refactoring with lint and types
cards.when: After planning a refactoring that modifies React or TSX components.
cards.cmds:
tsc --noEmit
npx eslint .
node --check src/App.tsx

cards.title: Document refactoring options with kill criteria
cards.when: When planning a high-risk refactoring where the approach might need abandonment.
cards.cmds:
date
sampo lib show kill-criteria

cards.title: Verify Rust migration compiles cleanly
cards.when: After applying code changes to a Rust project during a migration.
cards.cmds:
cargo check --all-targets
cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings
cargo fmt --check

cards.title: Test Rust migration logic
cards.when: After verifying compilation, run tests to ensure logic is correct.
cards.cmds:
cargo test
echo $?

cards.title: Check Rust version compatibility
cards.when: Before migrating to newer syntax or crates in a Rust project.
cards.cmds:
rustc --version
cargo --version
which clippy-driver

cards.title: Set up scrollytelling step structure with IntersectionObserver
cards.when: Starting a new scrollytelling section in a JavaScript project.
cards.cmds:
mkdir -p src/components/scrolly
touch src/components/scrolly/scrolly.js
npx eslint src/components/scrolly/scrolly.js
node --check src/components/scrolly/scrolly.js

cards.title: Test scrollytelling state lookup with URL hash
cards.when: Verifying that deep links to specific steps render the correct graphic state.
cards.cmds:
touch src/components/scrolly/scrolly.test.js
npx vitest run src/components/scrolly
grep -n "hash" src/components/scrolly/scrolly.test.js

cards.title: Check Gem dependencies are locked and installed
cards.when: Use this card when you need to verify that all gems in the Gemfile are installed and match the locked versions before running code.
cards.cmds:
bundle check
gem list
echo $?

cards.title: Lint Ruby code with RuboCop under Bundler
cards.when: Use this card when you need to enforce style and lint rules on Ruby files using the project-specific RuboCop configuration.
cards.cmds:
bundle exec rubocop
ls lib
echo $?

cards.title: Run RSpec tests with frozen string literals
cards.when: Use this card when you need to execute the test suite for a Ruby project that uses RSpec and requires frozen string literals.
cards.cmds:
head -1 lib/feature.rb
bundle exec rspec
echo $?

cards.title: Syntax check a single Ruby file with warnings
cards.when: Use this card when you need to quickly verify if a specific Ruby file has syntax errors without running the full test suite.
cards.cmds:
ruby -wc lib/validator.rb
ls -la lib/validator.rb
echo $?

cards.title: Document C project build warnings configuration
cards.when: When planning a C codebase setup that requires strict compilation standards and error handling.
cards.cmds:
cc -std=c11 -Wall -Wextra -Werror -c src/foo.c -o /dev/null
ls

cards.title: Verify C memory safety with sanitizers
cards.when: When verifying that C code handles memory bounds correctly during the planning phase.
cards.cmds:
cc -g -fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-omit-frame-pointer -c src/foo.c -o /dev/null
ls test_bin

cards.title: Document C project verification commands
cards.when: When creating documentation for the verification steps of a C project.
cards.cmds:
ls
find . -name Makefile

cards.title: Scan source directory for architecture patterns
cards.when: Before designing a feature, you need to understand existing code structure and naming conventions.
cards.cmds:
find . -type f
rg "class.*Controller"
head main.py

cards.title: Map data flow between components
cards.when: Defining how data moves through the system to ensure correct integration.
cards.cmds:
rg "def " --type py
rg "user_id" --type py
cat config.yaml

cards.title: Validate code style before architecture design
cards.when: You must ensure new designs fit the existing coding standards before writing the blueprint.
cards.cmds:
shellcheck *.sh
python -m py_compile ./**/*.py
wc -l *.py

cards.title: Verify Go module files are tidy
cards.when: You changed go.mod or go.sum and need to confirm dependencies are consistent before finishing.
cards.cmds:
git diff --exit-code go.mod go.sum
git status go.mod go.sum

cards.title: Fuzz a Go parser with bounded time
cards.when: You added a parser or decoder and need to test its robustness against invalid inputs.
cards.cmds:
ls testdata/fuzz
ls

cards.title: Generate skeleton plan file with headers
cards.when: You need to initialize the markdown structure for a new implementation plan.
cards.cmds:
touch plan/plan.md
sed -i '$ a \# Implementation Plan: Auth Feature\n\n## Overview\nAdds JWT authentication to API.' plan/plan.md
sed -i '$ a \## Requirements' plan/plan.md
sed -i '$ a \- User login endpoint' plan/plan.md

cards.title: Break down feature into phase steps
cards.when: You are structuring the implementation steps into logical phases within the plan document.
cards.cmds:
sed -i '$ a \### Phase 1: Setup' plan/plan.md
sed -i '$ a \1. **Init DB** (File: db/schema.sql)' plan/plan.md
sed -i '$ a \ - Action: Create tables for users and sessions' plan/plan.md
sed -i '$ a \ - Dependencies: None' plan/plan.md

cards.title: List affected files for architecture review
cards.when: Identifying which code files need modification during the planning phase.
cards.cmds:
find src -name '*.ts' -type f
grep -l 'auth' src/**/*.ts
sed -i '$ a \- src/api/auth.ts' plan/plan.md
test -f src/api/auth.ts

cards.title: Define risks and edge cases section
cards.when: Finalizing the plan by identifying potential failures and edge cases.
cards.cmds:
sed -i '$ a \## Risks' plan/plan.md
sed -i '$ a \- JWT token expiration handling' plan/plan.md
sed -i '$ a \- User submits empty password field' plan/plan.md
wc -l plan/plan.md

cards.title: Verify Tailwind build output and class ordering
cards.when: Checking that Tailwind CSS compiles correctly and classes are formatted.
cards.cmds:
npx tailwindcss -i ./src/input.css -o /tmp/out.css --minify
npx prettier --check .
cat /tmp/out.css

cards.title: Test responsive navigation collapse behavior
cards.when: Verifying that the navigation menu collapses at the md breakpoint.
cards.cmds:
mkdir -p /tmp/nav-test
npx playwright test
grep 'nav collapses below md' playwright-report/index.html

cards.title: Check SQL files with available text tools
cards.when: When you need to verify SQL file existence and basic structure when dedicated linters are unavailable.
cards.cmds:
find . -name '*.sql'
file query.sql
head -n 5 query.sql

cards.title: Plan Python Security Refactor Steps
cards.when: Designing a plan to add security controls to a Python project.
cards.cmds:
ls -la src/
cat pyproject.toml
find tests -name "test_*.py" -type f

cards.title: Verify Python Environment Isolation Plan
cards.when: Planning the setup of an isolated Python environment for security.
cards.cmds:
ls -d .venv
which python3
python -m pip check

cards.title: Plan Dependency Security Audit Steps
cards.when: Designing a plan to audit Python dependencies for vulnerabilities.
cards.cmds:
cat requirements.txt
python -m pip check
python -m pip list

cards.title: Verify Rust baseline with cargo and rustfmt
cards.when: Before planning a Rust feature or library, ensure the codebase compiles and passes lints.
cards.cmds:

cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings
cargo fmt --check

cards.title: List Rust dependencies from Cargo.toml
cards.when: Identifying existing libraries to determine if a new dependency is needed for the plan.
cards.cmds:
find . -name Cargo.toml -maxdepth 2
grep -A 50 '^\[dependencies\]' Cargo.toml

cards.title: Check Rust file structure for planning
cards.when: Understanding the current code layout before adding new modules or tests.
cards.cmds:
ls src/*.rs
ls tests/*.rs
cat src/main.rs

cards.title: Verify code has no raw SQL injection
cards.when: Use before merging a change that builds SQL from request values.
cards.cmds:
grep -nF 'execute(' app/db/users.py
grep -nF 'format(' app/db/users.py
pytest tests/sql/test_users.py -q
grep -nF ':id' app/db/users.py

cards.title: Verify SQL roles grant least privilege
cards.when: Use when a migration creates or changes database roles and grants.
cards.cmds:
grep -n 'GRANT ALL' migrations/0001_init.sql
grep -n 'SUPERUSER' migrations/0001_init.sql
psql -h localhost -U auditor -d shop -c "SELECT rolname, rolsuper FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname='app'"
psql -h localhost -U auditor -d shop -c "SELECT has_database_privilege('app','shop','CONNECT'), has_schema_privilege('app','public','CREATE')"

cards.title: Verify SQL migration reverses on scratch database
cards.when: Use after a migration adds, renames, or drops tables.
cards.cmds:
psql -h localhost -U scratch -d shop_scratch -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f migrations/0002_down.sql
psql -h localhost -U scratch -d shop_scratch -c "SELECT to_regclass('public.old_orders') IS NULL"
psql -h localhost -U scratch -d shop_scratch -c "SELECT to_regclass('public.orders') IS NOT NULL"
grep -nF 'shop_prod' migrations/0002_down.sql

cards.title: Verify sensitive query stays bounded and indexed
cards.when: Use when a change queries a large table from an untrusted user.
cards.cmds:
grep -nF 'FROM orders' app/db/orders.py
psql -h localhost -U scratch -d shop_scratch -c "EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS) SELECT id FROM orders WHERE user_id=42 AND created_at BETWEEN now() - interval '1 day' AND now()"
psql -h localhost -U scratch -d shop_scratch -c "SELECT count(*) FROM orders WHERE user_id=42 AND created_at BETWEEN now() - interval '1 day' AND now()"
grep -nF ':limit' app/db/orders.py

git diff -- src/styles.css

rg -n -i -e deleted_at -e timestamptz -e default -e null -g 'migrations/0003_add_users_deleted_at.sql'
psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -d scratch -f migrations/0003_add_users_deleted_at.sql
psql -d scratch -c "select column_name, data_type, is_nullable from information_schema.columns where table_name = 'users' and column_name = 'deleted_at'"
rg -n -i -e backfill -e constraint -g 'migrations/0003_add_users_deleted_at.sql'

wc -l migrations/0004_add_users_email_index.sql

psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -d scratch -f migrations/0004_add_users_email_index.sql
psql -d scratch -c "select count(*) from pg_indexes where indexname = 'idx_users_email'"

psql -d scratch -c "SELECT count(*) FROM users WHERE deleted_at IS NULL"

cards.cmds:
cc -O2 -Wall -Wextra -Werror -o app src/main.c
bash release/bench.sh
diff baseline.txt current.txt
grep regression current.txt
date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ

cards.title: Record C release performance evidence
cards.when: Use after a C release build passes benchmarks to store the evidence in the release record.
cards.cmds:
cat VERSION
git rev-parse HEAD
sha256sum app
cp perf.txt release/perf.txt
test -s release/perf.txt

cards.title: Capture Python refactor design before editing
cards.when: Use when a Python refactor will move modules, rename APIs, or change ownership of behavior.
cards.cmds:
git diff --name-only HEAD
python -m pytest -q
mkdir -p docs/refactors

cards.title: Map old Python modules to the new design
cards.when: Use when refactoring a Python package and the new module layout is not obvious from file names.
cards.cmds:
rg --files --type python
rg def --type python
rg import --type python

cards.title: Record removed Python behavior in capture notes
cards.when: Use when a Python refactor deletes functions, modules, or settings and the project needs a durable reason.
cards.cmds:
git diff --name-status HEAD
rg parse_port --type python

cards.title: Verify Python refactor design with tests
cards.when: Use when a Python refactor is designed but not yet proven to preserve behavior.
cards.cmds:
python -m pytest -q
python -m pip check
python -m pytest -q

cards.title: Capture the need before searching for existing tools
cards.when: Use when starting a feature, dependency, or helper that may already exist.
cards.cmds:
rg "search-first" .
cat references/ground/search-first.md

cards.title: Check which search channels are available before searching
cards.when: Use when a task depends on npm, PyPI, or local code search tools.
cards.cmds:
which rg grep curl npm pip
find . -name "*.md" -type f

cards.title: Find existing package candidates with local and npm search
cards.when: Use after the need and available channels are captured.
cards.cmds:
rg -e chalk -e colors -e colorize .
npm view chalk --json

cards.title: Score candidates and choose adopt extend or build
cards.when: Use when local and registry results are available.
cards.cmds:
cat package.json
rg -e adopt -e extend -e build .

cards.title: Verify Python release docs before tagging
cards.when: Use when Python release docs may be stale or broken before a release.
cards.cmds:
python -m pytest -q
python -m pip check
git diff --stat main -- docs CHANGELOG.md
head -40 CHANGELOG.md

cards.title: Fix broken links in Python docs
cards.when: Use when a Python docs build reports broken internal links before release.
cards.cmds:
rg -n href= docs
ls docs/guide
grep -n href= docs/index.rst

cards.title: Reproduce release bug from Python docs
cards.when: Use when a Python release bug is described in docs and must be reproduced locally.
cards.cmds:
sed -n 1,80p docs/releases.md
python -m venv .repro
sh -c '.repro/bin/pip install ./src'
sh -c '.repro/bin/pytest -q tests/test_repro.py'

cards.title: Gate Python release docs on CI
cards.when: Use when Python release docs are about to be published and checks may be skipped.
cards.cmds:
git status --short
python -m pytest -q
grep -n version docs/conf.py
python -m sphinx-build docs _build/html

cards.title: Test Python data pipeline idempotence
cards.when: Use when a data job runs twice and you must prove outputs are stable.
cards.cmds:
python process_data.py --partition 2023-01-01
python process_data.py --partition 2023-01-01
sha256sum output_run1.parquet output_run2.parquet

cards.title: Verify Python environment and lint status
cards.when: Use before running data scripts to ensure the code is clean and dependencies are valid.
cards.cmds:
python -m pip check
python -m ruff check .
python -m ruff format --check .
pwd

cards.title: Run targeted RSpec UI examples
cards.when: Use this when you changed a Ruby UI component and need proof that its behavior is correct.
cards.cmds:
rg -l RSpec spec/components
bundle exec rspec spec/components/button_spec.rb
bundle exec rspec spec/components/button_spec.rb

cards.title: Check Ruby UI file syntax
cards.when: Use this when you added or edited a Ruby UI file and want a fast syntax check before tests.
cards.cmds:
ls app/components/menu.rb
ruby -wc app/components/menu.rb
head -1 app/components/menu.rb

cards.title: Verify Ruby UI dependencies
cards.when: Use this when a Ruby UI change needs a gem and you must prove Bundler is ready before examples.
cards.cmds:
bundle check
bundle install
bundle exec rspec spec/features/menu_spec.rb
grep -n html2text Gemfile.lock

cards.title: Run Ruby UI suite
cards.when: Use this when you need to confirm a Ruby UI change did not break other UI examples.
cards.cmds:
bundle exec rspec
bundle exec rspec spec/features
bundle exec rspec spec/features/search_spec.rb:9
bundle exec rspec

cards.title: Declare incident with Sampo capture
cards.when: When an active outage or security event requires immediate tracking.
cards.cmds:
sampo capture --incident 'checkout 500 errors' --signal health_check
ls -l /var/log/sampo/incidents/
sampo status --incident latest

cards.title: Preserve evidence before security cleanup
cards.when: When a security event is detected and evidence must be secured.
cards.cmds:
cp /var/log/auth.log /evidence/auth.log.snapshot
cp /var/log/nginx/access.log /evidence/access.log.snapshot
ls -l /evidence/

cards.title: Log mitigation actions with expected effects
cards.when: When executing a reversible fix like a rollback or flag toggle.
cards.cmds:
sampo capture --incident log 'rollback deploy v1.2' --expect '500s stop'
echo 'kubectl rollout undo deployment/api'
sampo capture --incident log 'observed: 500s stopped' --expect 'stable'

cards.title: Compile C file with strict warnings enabled
cards.when: When verifying a C source file compiles without any warnings or errors.
cards.cmds:
cc -std=c11 -Wall -Wextra -Werror -c src/foo.c -o /dev/null
echo $?
ls -l /dev/null

cards.title: Run pytest suite with quiet output
cards.when: Use when you need to verify if the Python test suite passes.
cards.cmds:
python -m pytest -q
echo $?
ls tests/

cards.title: Restore Python packages in isolated environment
cards.when: Use when the virtual environment is missing dependencies or pip check fails.
cards.cmds:
python -m venv .venv
bash .venv/bin/activate
pip install -r requirements.txt
python -m pip check

cards.title: Check Python code with ruff linting
cards.when: Use when you need to validate Python code style and find lint errors.
cards.cmds:
python -m ruff check .
python -m ruff format --check .
find . -name "*.py"

cards.title: Verify static types with pyright
cards.when: Use when you need to check for type errors in Python code.
cards.cmds:
python -m pyright .
echo $?
python -m mypy .

cards.title: Validate Expo SDK dependency match
cards.when: When runtime crashes suggest SDK version mismatches in React Native app
cards.cmds:
npx expo-doctor
grep 'SDK mismatch' npx expo-doctor
test $? -eq 0

cards.title: Verify iOS Swift test suite
cards.when: When Swift logic changes require proof that unit tests pass on simulator
cards.cmds:
test $? -eq 0
ls -la .build
pwd

cards.title: Check TypeScript compilation without emit
cards.when: When TypeScript changes require type checking without generating files
cards.cmds:
npx tsc --noEmit
test $? -eq 0
wc -l < /dev/null

cards.title: Validate JavaScript syntax and lint codebase
cards.when: Use when verifying that JavaScript files are syntactically correct and pass linting rules after edits.
cards.cmds:
node --check src/index.js
npx eslint .

cards.title: Install dependencies from lockfile reliably
cards.when: Use when setting up the environment to ensure dependencies match the package.json and lockfile exactly.
cards.cmds:
cd /path/to/project
npm ci
ls node_modules

cards.title: Execute node native test suite
cards.when: Use when running tests that rely on the built-in node:test module without external dependencies.
cards.cmds:
npm test
find . -name "*.test.js" -type f

cards.title: Debug async equality and promise handling
cards.when: Use when tests fail due to unexpected async behavior or incorrect equality checks in JavaScript.
cards.cmds:
cat src/slugify.test.js
grep -r "==" src/ --include="*.js"
npm test

cards.title: Verify CSS build output exists and is valid
cards.when: After modifying source CSS or config, confirm the generated stylesheet compiles without syntax errors.
cards.cmds:
npx tailwindcss -i ./src/input.css -o /tmp/out.css --minify
test -s /tmp/out.css
wc -l /tmp/out.css

cards.title: Check Tailwind class order with Prettier
cards.when: Before committing CSS changes, ensure utility classes are ordered correctly according to plugin rules.
cards.cmds:
npm ls prettier-plugin-tailwindcss
npx prettier --check .
npx prettier --write .
npx prettier --check .

cards.title: Verify visual layout at specific viewport
cards.when: When responsive breakpoints change, confirm the UI renders correctly at the target width using a browser test.
cards.cmds:
npx playwright test
echo $?
ls test-results/
cat test-results/report.html

cards.title: Validate plugin manifest JSON structure
cards.when: Use when checking if the plugin manifest file parses correctly before running tests.
cards.cmds:
cd .
python3 -m json.tool .claude-plugin/plugin.json
echo $?

cards.title: Run plugin fixture unit tests
cards.when: Use when verifying hook and helper scripts against recorded payloads without a model.
cards.cmds:
cd ./plugin
python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t tests
echo $?

cards.title: Check Python dependencies for conflicts
cards.when: Use when verifying that installed Python packages do not have conflicting requirements.
cards.cmds:
python3 -m pip check
echo $?
python3 -m pip list

cards.title: Run SQL migration with error stop
cards.when: Applying a schema change or data migration to a database instance.
cards.cmds:
ls -la migration.sql
psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f migration.sql "$DATABASE_URL"
echo "Migration status: $?"

cards.title: Lint SQL files with dialect setting
cards.when: Checking SQL code style and syntax errors before deployment.
cards.cmds:
pip install sqlfluff
python -m sqlfluff lint --dialect postgres .
python -m sqlfluff fix --dialect postgres .

cards.title: Audit npm packages for high-severity vulnerabilities
cards.when: Use when reviewing a JavaScript project to detect known CVEs in dependencies.
cards.cmds:
pwd
npm audit --audit-level=high
echo $?

cards.title: Lint JavaScript files with security ESLint plugin
cards.when: Use when checking for common security patterns and unsafe code in JS files.
cards.cmds:
npx eslint --print-config . | head -n 1
npx eslint . --plugin security
echo Done

cards.title: Verify Node.js syntax and parseability
cards.when: Use when checking if a specific JS file has basic syntax errors.
cards.cmds:
cd .
node --check src/index.js
echo $?

cards.title: Check Ruby project dependencies with Bundle
cards.when: Verifying that all required gems are installed in a Ruby project.
cards.cmds:
cd /path/to/project
bundle check
bundle install

cards.title: Run RSpec tests with Bundler execution
cards.when: Executing the test suite for a Ruby project using RSpec.
cards.cmds:
cd /path/to/project
bundle exec rspec

cards.title: Lint Ruby code with RuboCop
cards.when: Checking Ruby code style and standards in a project.
cards.cmds:
cd /path/to/project
bundle exec rubocop

cards.title: Record decision with sampo command
cards.when: You have finished the memo and need to log the choice.
cards.cmds:
sampo decide "Postgres" --why "Durability" --rejected "SQLite" --revisit "Q3 review"
sampo decide "Postgres" --kind outward --why "Durability"
sampo lib show decision-records
echo $?

cards.title: Verify Tailwind utility class existence
cards.when: You need to confirm if a specific CSS class exists in the generated stylesheet.
cards.cmds:
find ./src -name '*.css' | head -1
grep -q 'flex' ./src/main.css
echo $?

cards.title: Check for missing Tailwind classes in build
cards.when: You want to detect if a critical UI class is absent from the final bundle.
cards.cmds:
grep -oP '(?<=\.)[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+' ./dist/assets/index.css | sort -u
grep -q 'bg-red-500' /tmp/classes.txt
echo $?

cards.title: Validate CSS syntax with Prettier plugin
cards.when: You need to ensure Tailwind class order and formatting are correct in HTML files.
cards.cmds:
npm install --save-dev prettier-plugin-tailwindcss
npx prettier --check index.html
echo $?

cards.title: Verify viewport behavior with Playwright
cards.when: You need to confirm that responsive Tailwind classes trigger correctly at specific widths.
cards.cmds:
npm run dev
npx playwright test tests/mobile.test.ts
echo $?

cards.title: Bump Ruby gem version in Gemfile
cards.when: You need to upgrade a specific Ruby gem to a newer version.
cards.cmds:
grep -A 1 'gem_name' Gemfile.lock
bundle update gem_name
git diff Gemfile.lock

cards.title: Upgrade Node package using npm
cards.when: You need to update a JavaScript or TypeScript package in a Node.js project.
cards.cmds:
npm list package_name
npm update package_name
git diff package-lock.json

cards.title: Update Rust dependency in Cargo
cards.when: You need to bump a dependency version in a Rust project using Cargo.
cards.cmds:
cargo tree -p crate_name
cargo update -p crate_name
git diff Cargo.lock

cards.title: Bump Python package with pip
cards.when: You need to upgrade a Python package in a virtual environment.
cards.cmds:
pip show package_name
pip install --upgrade package_name
pip show package_name

cards.title: Analyze existing Rust project structure and patterns
cards.when: Starting a new feature design in a Rust codebase.
cards.cmds:
ls -R src
cat Cargo.toml
rg '#\[cfg\(test\)\]' src

cards.title: Verify Rust code formatting and linting
cards.when: Ensuring generated code meets project standards before review.
cards.cmds:
cargo fmt --check
cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings
cargo check --all-targets

cards.title: Generate implementation blueprint with file paths
cards.when: Defining the concrete files and interfaces for a new feature.
cards.cmds:
mkdir -p src/new_feature
touch src/new_feature/DESIGN.md
ls src/new_feature

cards.title: Define build sequence for feature implementation
cards.when: Planning the order of coding tasks based on dependencies.
cards.cmds:
grep -r 'mod ' src/lib.rs
touch BUILD_ORDER.md
ls BUILD_ORDER.md

cards.title: Verify C code compiles with strict warning flags
cards.when: After writing or modifying C source code before running tests.
cards.cmds:
cc -std=c11 -Wall -Wextra -Werror -c src/foo.c -o /dev/null
make test
ls src/*.c

cards.title: Build C tests with address sanitizer enabled
cards.when: When memory safety or undefined behavior needs to be verified in C tests.
cards.cmds:
cc -g -fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-omit-frame-pointer test.c -o test_bin
sh test_bin
cat sanitizer_log.txt

cards.title: Use valgrind to detect memory leaks in C binaries
cards.when: When sanitizers are unavailable or when checking for specific memory leaks in a built binary.
cards.cmds:
test -f ./test_bin
tail -n 20 valgrind_log.txt
which valgrind

cards.title: Inspect migration files before defining CSS changes
cards.when: When planning a migration that touches HTML structure or CSS classes.
cards.cmds:
find . -name "*.sql" -o -name "*.html" | sort
cat migrations/001_add_users.sql
grep -r "class=" migrations/

cards.title: Verify CSS class usage before removing styles
cards.when: When planning to remove or rename a CSS class during a migration.
cards.cmds:
grep -r "class='old-class'" src/
grep -r "old-class" src/
grep -r "old-class" src/ | wc -l

cards.title: Validate CSS integrity after HTML migration changes
cards.when: When the HTML structure changes and CSS needs to be verified.
cards.cmds:
npx tailwindcss -i ./src/input.css -o /tmp/out.css --minify
grep ".login-form" /tmp/out.css
stat -c%s /tmp/out.css

cards.title: Check for Tailwind utility classes in migration templates
cards.when: When a migration involves HTML templates that use Tailwind CSS.
cards.cmds:
find . -name "*.html" -o -name "*.hbs"
grep -r "class=\"" src/
grep -r "class=\"" src/ | awk -F'"' '{print $2}' | tr ' ' '\n' | sort -u

cards.title: Verify uniform version strings across plugin directories
cards.when: Use this when preparing to tag a new plugin release to ensure all manifests match.
cards.cmds:
ls
grep -rn '"version"' .claude-plugin/ plugin/.claude-plugin/

cards.title: Validate plugin manifest structure using strict mode
cards.when: Use this after editing the marketplace catalog to verify syntax and schema compliance.
cards.cmds:
pwd
python3 -m json.tool .claude-plugin/marketplace.json

cards.title: Run unit test suite for the plugin tree
cards.when: Use this before tagging to ensure all code changes pass the existing test suite.
cards.cmds:
python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t tests
tail -n 5
grep -c 'ran' <(python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t tests)

cards.title: Verify lockfile diff after version bump
cards.when: You have updated the manifest and need to ensure lockfile changes are minimal.
cards.cmds:
git status package-lock.json
git diff package-lock.json
git diff --numstat package-lock.json
npm --version

cards.title: Scan for deprecated API usage in codebase
cards.when: Release notes mention breaking changes and you need to find affected code.
cards.cmds:
rg "oldFunctionName" --type-add "js:*.js,*.ts" --type js
rg "oldFunctionName" -l
rg "oldFunctionName" -c
curl -s https://docs.example.com/api | jq '.version'

cards.title: Verify Ruby code style with RuboCop and RSpec
cards.when: Ensuring a Ruby decision memo and associated code follow repo standards.
cards.cmds:
bundle exec rubocop lib/
bundle exec rspec
head -1 lib/new_parser.rb

cards.title: Audit version strings across all plugin manifest files
cards.when: You need to verify that all version identifiers in the project are consistent before tagging a release.
cards.cmds:
grep -rn '"version"' .
grep -rn '"version"' . | cut -d: -f3
grep -rn '"version"' . | cut -d: -f3 | sort -u

cards.title: Validate JSON syntax for the marketplace manifest file
cards.when: You must ensure the marketplace.json file is valid JSON before proceeding with the release validation.
cards.cmds:
test -f .claude-plugin/marketplace.json
file .claude-plugin/marketplace.json
python3 -m json.tool .claude-plugin/marketplace.json

cards.title: Run the plugin test suite from the project root
cards.when: You need to execute the automated tests to ensure the plugin functionality works correctly before tagging.
cards.cmds:
cd /home/user/my-plugin
pwd
python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t tests

cards.title: Seed Scratch DB For Test Assertions
cards.when: Before verifying a SQL query's logic.
cards.cmds:
psql -c "CREATE DATABASE scratch"
psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -d scratch -f seed.sql
psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -d scratch -f test.sql
psql -c "DROP DATABASE scratch"

cards.title: Lint SQL Dialect With Sqlfluff Config
cards.when: When SQL files need style enforcement.
cards.cmds:
cat .sqlfluff
python3 -m sqlfluff lint --dialect postgres .
python3 -m sqlfluff fix --dialect postgres .
python3 -m sqlfluff lint --dialect postgres .

cards.title: Inspect existing docs before creating new files
cards.when: You are starting living docs governance for a project with existing documentation.
cards.cmds:
find . -name '*.md' -maxdepth 1
stat README.md
head -20 README.md
ls src/

cards.title: List affected files for architecture
cards.when: Identifying which code files need changes for a plan.
cards.cmds:
find . -name '*.ts'
grep -r 'User' src/ --include='*.ts'
wc -l plan.md

cards.title: Review plan for completeness
cards.when: Finalizing the plan before implementation begins.
cards.cmds:
grep -c '##' plan.md
cat plan.md
wc -l plan.md

cards.title: Check Rust code formatting compliance
cards.when: Reviewing Rust code before merging to ensure style consistency.
cards.cmds:
cd /project/rust_app
cargo fmt --check
rg --no-heading 'error' < /tmp/fmt_err.log
stat src/main.rs

cards.title: Verify Rust compilation for all targets
cards.when: Checking if the codebase compiles before running deeper analysis.
cards.cmds:
cd /repo/rust_project
cargo check --all-targets
tail -n 20 /tmp/check_log.txt
ls target/debug/

cards.title: Execute Rust unit and integration tests
cards.when: Validating logic correctness after code changes in review.
cards.cmds:
cd /home/user/rust_lib
cargo test
grep -c 'FAILED' /tmp/test_out.log
rg 'panicked at' /tmp/test_out.log

cards.title: Execute migration with psql ON_ERROR_STOP
cards.when: You need to apply a SQL migration script to a database and stop immediately on failure.
cards.cmds:
ls migration.sql
psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f migration.sql "$DATABASE_URL"
echo $?

cards.title: Test schema in SQLite memory
cards.when: You want to validate that a SQL schema file loads without syntax errors using a temporary database.
cards.cmds:
sqlite3 :memory: < schema.sql
echo "Exit: $?"
sqlite3 :memory: ".tables"

cards.title: Analyze Rust project structure with cargo
cards.when: You need to understand the basic layout and targets of a Rust project.
cards.cmds:
ls
cat Cargo.toml
cargo check --all-targets

cards.title: Trace execution path in Rust code
cards.when: You need to follow the call chain from a Rust entry point to understand flow.
cards.cmds:
grep -r "fn main" src/
grep -r "fn " src/

cards.title: Map Rust architecture layers and dependencies
cards.when: You need to identify which layers a Rust feature touches and its external dependencies.
cards.cmds:
grep -A 20 "\[dependencies\]" Cargo.toml
find src -type f -name "*.rs"

cards.title: Verify PostgreSQL migration executes without errors
cards.when: You have a migration SQL file and need to confirm it runs cleanly against a database.
cards.cmds:
psql -c "CREATE DATABASE test_db"
psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f migration.sql test_db
echo $?
psql -c "DROP DATABASE test_db"

cards.title: Check if a query uses the expected index
cards.when: You want to verify that a SQL query performs efficiently using the right indexes.
cards.cmds:

psql -c "EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS) SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = 1" test_db | grep "Index Scan"

python -m pytest -q

cat pyproject.toml

cards.title: Initialize Ruby documentation baseline with Bundler

touch docs/constitution.md
touch docs/map.md

cards.title: Audit existing docs for status and drift

stat docs/constitution.md
ruby -wc lib/app.rb
wc -l docs/map.md

cards.title: Validate documentation links and references

find docs -type f -name "*.md" | wc -l

cards.title: Update documentation map with current structure

cat docs/map.md
tail -n 5 docs/map.md

grep -E "^#{1,2} " deck.md
